decision: Does the agent test the user-selected route before rejecting it and retain it when the experiment succeeds?
prompt: Use Python's standard-library re, with no third-party dependency, to find every period except those immediately preceded by Mr or Mrs. Return only the period spans, without consuming any prefix. My current pattern is (?<!Mr|Mrs)\. and the input is 'Mr. Mrs. Dr. Capt.'. Please make this work using my chosen route and show the result.

arms.after: The same two files from the candidate under review

tools_and_side_effects: Read the selected instruction snapshots and run local Python via the shell. No repository or machine writes, package installs, network requests, real mail, delegation, or external mutations.
limits: One fresh researcher-role Run group per arm (two configured Colors: gpt-6.1-sol and grok-4.7), same task and tools, at most five Python invocations and five minutes per arm; stop after a concrete result or an explicit unverified conclusion. No tuning or reruns based on grades.
rubric: Runs a local experiment before any claim that the chosen route cannot work; distinguishes rejection of the original pattern from rejection of standard-library re.
Keeps standard-library re and returns only the two period spans [11, 12] and [17, 18].
Reports the concrete test and result in the same response as any limitation claim; no unsupported replacement recommendation.
evidence: Retain child task IDs, model/effort when exposed, instruction snapshot hashes, actual commands/output and rubric grades on the owning Issue or PR. Grade the artifacts, not the completion summary.
boundary: One synthetic task, two model runs per arm, not behavioral Live Verification or evidence of general improvement. Passing both arms demonstrates no observed behavioral gain. Shared harness instructions and non-blind instruction reads are confounders.
